sloka: क्षिप्ताश्चापि शरास्तेन शस्त्राणि विविधानि च ।न रणार्थाय वर्तन्ते मृत्युकाले ऽभिवर्ततः ।। ६.१०५.२९ ।।
transliteration: kṣiptāścāpi śarāstena śastrāṇi vividhāni ca ।na raṇārthāya vartante mṛtyukāle 'bhivartataḥ ।। 6.105.29 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's arrows of several kinds being destroyed, perceiving that his death is objective Rama's missiles, and that the time of death appeared, he was unable to act.
